test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

When you are under significant stress, it is hardly to process details and nuances.
solution:
The correct answer is **significant stress, it is hardly.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The part that contains the error from the given options is significant stress, it is hardly.
 
• The word is **hardly **used for it in **mid position, or before an adjective or a noun**. 
 
• Thus the word **hard** will use instead of **Hardly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hardly- It hardly has a negative connotation. It usually indicates 'nearly not at all' or 'just barely'. It can be used in the middle of a sentence, or before an adjective or a noun.

 
 
• **Examples- ***He hardly knew how it tasted.*
 
• *Hardly had they spoken these words when the door opened and Arion himself stood before them.*
 
 
 
• *​***Hard** means are **solid, firm, and rigid.**
 
• Its synonym** is firm, solid, dense, rigid etc.**
 
• Its antonym is **soft, light etc.**
 
 
• **​Examples- ***I can see why Alex fell so hard for you. *
 
• *It was hard to tell.*
